implementation.instructions: For the scoped obligation, judge the supplied diff evidence only. Choose 'implemented' if the obligation is fully satisfied, 'partial' if some part is missing or incomplete, 'contradicted' if the diff does the opposite or violates the obligation, 'not_addressed' if no supplied change addresses it, or 'ambiguous' if the supplied evidence is insufficient to decide. The newest item marked supersedes_older wins when spec texts conflict. Repository policy excerpts describe deliberate patterns that are not findings.

criteria.implemented: The obligation is fully satisfied by the supplied diff
criteria.partial: Some part of the obligation is missing or incomplete
criteria.contradicted: The diff does the opposite or violates the obligation
criteria.not_addressed: No supplied change addresses the obligation
criteria.ambiguous: The supplied evidence is insufficient to decide

real_outcome_test.instructions: Judge whether a changed test in the supplied diff asserts the requested real outcome (actual output files, exit codes, written bytes, observable behavior) rather than only verifying mocked or internal calls. Return the probability that this judgment is NOUL (the test does NOT assert a real outcome).

criteria.true: The changed test does NOT assert a real outcome; it only verifies mocked or internal calls
criteria.false: The changed test asserts the requested real outcome

unrelated_behavior.instructions: Judge whether the supplied diff introduces behavior changes outside the scope of the explicit spec obligations (ignoring docs, formatting, and mechanical refactors the spec itself requires). Return the probability that this judgment is NOUL (the diff DOES introduce unrelated behavior).

criteria.true: The diff DOES introduce unrelated behavior changes
criteria.false: The diff stays within the scope of the explicit spec obligations

docs_sync.instructions: For the scoped obligation, judge documentation synchronization from the supplied diff evidence only. Choose 'docs_synchronized' when affected docs are updated, 'docs_not_required' when the obligation cannot affect user-facing docs, 'readme_missing' when README.md should have been updated, 'requirements_missing' when Requirements.md should have been updated, 'glossary_missing' when UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md should have been updated, or 'architecture_approval_missing' when an architecture-diagram deviation lacks approval. The newest item marked supersedes_older wins when spec texts conflict.

criteria.docs_synchronized: Affected docs are updated in the supplied diff
criteria.docs_not_required: The obligation cannot affect user-facing docs
criteria.readme_missing: README.md should have been updated but was not
criteria.requirements_missing: Requirements.md should have been updated but was not
criteria.glossary_missing: UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md should have been updated but was not
